title: Make the sim doors' 'demo corpus only' exemption true: one (SIM)-row gate
deviations_from_card: Added setSimApproval/openSimOfferToken beside resolveSimEntry (they take the branded SimEntry, not a bare id) so the source contract can forbid setApproval/getOpenOfferForEntry imports in sim routes, which is what acceptance case 7 asks for. The contract's second half only checks routes that READ an entryId from the request (apply-cv/inbound only echo one back). offer-link-scope.test.ts forbids the raw accessors by IMPORT, because the route's history comment names the old call. Only offer-draft and screen-draft have exemption rows in route-capability-coverage (offer-link is a GET, not in the ratchet), per the critic's note; apply-cv/inbound/reset rows unchanged. No catalog key: reuses SIM_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND.
notes: Case 8 (e2e token-doors-axe) was rewritten: the offer is minted on a (SIM) entry from POST /api/sim/inbound on the first seeded job that accepts it; erasure + invite tokens stay on the real entry. It was NOT run (needs a prod build, forbidden here) - the coordinator should run it against a prod build. tsc red only on foreign paths (app/features/hiring/decisions/useDecisionsScreenWave.ts, app/features/insights/about/chapters.test.ts, untracked kpi-sim/**). Full test:unit red only on sibling in-flight files (analyze-github-stage, job-workspace-state{,-tenancy}, decisionsWaveKeepKind, about/scenes/beats, AnalyzeApi). test:perf over on llm-config/job-ingest (known) plus app/page.tsx and devcase/lifecycle/[id]/approve - neither imports sim-entry.ts or any sim route, so sibling work. A sibling has useSimulationWalk.ts modified in-flight; the walk only calls the sim doors with its (SIM)-job entry, which the gate admits.
